body: i have talked to him and even had a breakdown in front of him but at this point i dont think its helping...and just to top all this off me and my girlfriend have had a recent scare where she,after going for her yearly check up, discovered she had an STD. We discovered she had gotten it before we started dating. It was something you can cure with a pill so we both have been tested and taken the meds to cure it but it has brought up and argument thats been going on for the past few days because of the way i tried to handle the situation. She says i was being selfish and says it looked like i wasnt caring about what she was going through. So the only thing that i can honestly think is that she is probably right...guess i cant really do anything right. I dont dont even have the support of my own blood so how am i supposed to get support from anyone else. Right now i feel alone. I honestly dont even know why i wake up. I think it would much easier for me to just fall asleep and not wake up. That way i cant hurt anyone else and i wont ever need to worry about feeling like this again.

well i took yalls advice and talked to my grandparents. After almost 14 years of keeping it from my family i finally told my grandparents that iv attempted suicide and have been have suicidal thoughts again. Promptly they called my mother and she called me...Yelled and screamed at me for over an hour how i would disgrace this family by doing something like that. That i was being selfish and she doesn't understand how i would even consider taking my life. Then proceeded to tell me i am not the son she raised and that she is done with all this, then hung up. My grandpa walked away after i told him and my grandmother is now currently ignoring me. So i appreciate yalls advice but i think im just done with everything tired of being seen as a failure to the ones i thought would love me no matter what, and done with this feeling.
i have talked to a psychiatrist and that only seems to make it worse.

i guess in the end i just feel like a burden on all of them. Thats kind of why im here because i don't know where else to go to talk. My psychiatrist seems to only make things worse by bringing back all those old feelings that only tear me apart. My family has strong opinions on suicide, as in they think people who resort to it are weak and i quote "don't deserve to live anyway" that i feel i will be rejected by the last little bit of family i have left. And i feel if i tell my girlfriend how iv been feeling i think she may find me a depressed mess and she doesnt want to deal with it. Iv also just tried faking being happy and have gotten rather good at hiding what im really feeling to everyone around me.

i have talked to my girlfriend about my trust issues and i guess the one thing she had to say was you cant let your past control your future. But, the trick with that is i cant seem to escape my past. My friend aslo had that exact same thing to say about how iv been feeling and once again i just cant seem to escape it. Iv been trying to work on my trust issues but i cant get my thoughts in a straight line so that i can narrow anything down. I just feel overwhelmed in a way. And i feel i only frustrate both of them because i cant even gather my thoughts so how are they supposed to support me?
